events.line: Milk prices were raised by Rs 2 per litre in May. Cooperative dairies implemented the hike first, followed by private companies. Before this, prices were increased on May 25 last year. events.line: India's drug pricing authority has approved a 50% price hike for essential anti-cancer drugs carboplatin and cisplatin.
